title: The people your travellers *write home* about.
intro: Our journeys pass through the gates of families we know by name. Building them into your programme keeps the money from tourism where it belongs: in the villages, with the people who cook, host and tell the stories.
note: Every photograph in this section shows a Georgian landscape, not the hosts or their homes. Host portraits will follow, with our hosts’ permission.

sisatura.name: Sisatura
sisatura.quote: What is better than Marika and Enry meeting you at the gate of Sisatura with a shot of chacha and a big smile?
sisatura.alt: Old wooden village houses on a steep green hillside, smoke rising from a chimney

facts.text: A family-run Megrelian ethno-village with traditional houses, a lake and an old water mill
Megrelian cooking (ghomi, elarji, gebzhalia) and a supra, the Georgian feast, led by a tamada

leila.name: Leila
leila.quote: Leila prepares the best khinkali while telling the story of her life, which could easily be an Oscar-winning movie.
leila.alt: A family house with a carved wooden balcony behind a sunlit lawn

vacheishvili.name: Vacheishvili Family
vacheishvili.line: A family we are proud to call friends, and a door we are always glad to knock on.
vacheishvili.alt: Horses grazing in a wide green mountain valley

samvel.name: Samvel & family
samvel.quote: Samvel and his family, with their super-warm hospitality, make you laugh all the time while serving delicious home-grown food.
samvel.alt: A calm lake reflecting wooded hills under a blue sky

aluda.name: Aluda
aluda.line: Every journey is better with a friend along the way. Aluda is one of ours.
aluda.alt: A high mountain pasture below jagged rocky peaks

maia.name: Maia
maia.line: Some welcomes need no translation. Maia’s is one of them.
maia.alt: A small town in a deep, forested gorge

more.title: Doors we keep *coming back to.*
more.quote: In Georgia there are countless people and families who deliver an unparalleled level of positive emotions — emotions you can never buy. Our mission is to support them.

cta: Plan a visit with our hosts
